title: LogRedactionRegistry
description: Error-shape rules for logs and spans (planning/11 §8, planning/14 §2-3): the one source the API logger, the API span sanitizer, the worker logger and the worker tracer read for which error class names, codes and Nest logger contexts may reach a sink, and how deep a cause chain is followed. Each shape is a regular-expression source anchored with ^ and $ that compiles unchanged in JavaScript (no flags) and Python (re.ASCII, full match): use ASCII classes only, so `\w` means [A-Za-z0-9_] in both. `vectors` are the labelled test values every implementation's tests check. Loosening a shape, raising maxCauseDepth or removing a vector weakens redaction and needs a security-privacy review; adding vectors is free.

errorNameShape.description: An error class name kept in a log `err.type` or a span `exception.type`: an identifier, dots allowed, at most 64 characters. Anything else is written as `Error`.

codeShape.description: An error code kept in a log `err.code` or a span `exception.type`: a Postgres SQLSTATE or a system code (upper case, digits, `_`), at most 32 characters.

maxCauseDepth.description: Cause links of a logged error that are followed; the bound also ends a circular chain.

nestContextShape.description: A Nest logger `context` kept as written: a PascalCase class name (`RoutesResolver`). Anything else is written as the redaction marker.

exceptionType.description: A span `exception.type` is kept when it matches errorNameShape or codeShape, else replaced by `Error`.

nestContext.description: A Nest logger `context` is kept when it matches nestContextShape, else redacted.

shape.description: A regular-expression source anchored at both ends
